svg.title: Detection, not prevention
svg.desc: Timeline of a rogue certificate under CT. At issuance the logs return SCTs and the browser accepts it. Within the maximum merge delay of 24 hours the logs publish it; a monitor alerts the owner; the certificate is revoked or the CA is distrusted. The attacker had a window of use, but could not stay hidden.

text.tspan: window of use: up to the MMD (24 h)
before CT: the first row is the whole story, and it stays secret.
CT cannot stop the first use. It guarantees there is a second act.
